meta.author:
Gateway
詞曲 / Matthew Harris, Kyle Lee
中譯詞 / 吳芳儀、周巽光

lines.a: 我的渴求 唯有祢能滿足我
lines.b: I have this thirst, only You can satisfy

lines.a: 焚燒我心 以祢炙熱的愛火
lines.b: My heart it burns, with an all-consuming fire

lines.a: 切切尋求 我就必定尋見祢
lines.b: I search and seek, but You're never hard to find
The more of You I see
The more that I desire

lines.a: 需要祢 勝過所呼吸的空氣
lines.b: I need You, more than the air that I breathe
You've captured my heart, every beat
You're pulling me closer

lines.a: 需要祢 在祢腳前傾倒自己
lines.b: I need You, all that I am at Your feet
To pour out my love, and to praise You
Over and over

lines.a: 無人能像祢 能與祢的愛相比
lines.b: There is no one else, there is nothing like Your love
With every taste I get
Jesus I can't get enough

lines.a: 更多認識祢 就更渴慕祢
lines.b: The more I know You, the more I want to
And I can't get enough

lines.a: 更多認識祢 就更渴慕祢
lines.b: The more I know You, the more I want to
And I can't get enough
You're all that I want
You're all that I need
You're my heart's desire
You're my everything
